name: 3B BlackBio Dx Ltd
summary: Established in 1972 and headquartered in Bhopal, India, 3B Blackbio Dx Limited specializes in the conception, production, and market distribution of sophisticated molecular diagnostic technologies. The company's core focus is on delivering solutions for pressing health concerns such as infectious diseases, oncology, human genetics, and the challenge of antimicrobial resistance, primarily serving the Indian market. Their comprehensive product portfolio includes qPCR-based assays, swift lateral flow rapid tests, and cutting-edge Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) molecular diagnostic kits. These offerings are designed to enable precise and dependable analysis of patient samples by diagnostic laboratories, marketed under reputable brands like TRUPCR, TRUNGS, and TRURAPID. Beyond diagnostics, 3B Blackbio Dx Limited also supplies agrochemical products and provides essential technical support and training services.
